Qualimetrix dev-main

Usage:
  command [options] [arguments]

Options:
  -h, --help                     Display help for the given command. When no command is given display help for the list command
      --silent                   Do not output any message
  -q, --quiet                    Only errors are displayed. All other output is suppressed
  -V, --version                  Display this application version
      --ansi|--no-ansi           Force (or disable --no-ansi) ANSI output
  -n, --no-interaction           Do not ask any interactive question
  -d, --working-dir=WORKING-DIR  Use the given directory as working directory
  -v|vv|vvv, --verbose           Increase the verbosity of messages: 1 for normal output, 2 for more verbose output and 3 for debug

Available commands for the "baseline" namespace:
  baseline:cleanup          List baseline entries nothing reports any more, and remove the ones you name
  baseline:explain          Show the effective boundary for a metric subject and where it comes from
  baseline:generate         Capture the current findings as a new baseline file
  baseline:rename-channels  Rewrite the channel names in a baseline file along a declared rename map
  baseline:update           Tighten an existing baseline against the current findings
